defects.title: register_scorer makes plugin loading non-idempotent: the design's own load_plugins (WP7) + register() (WP11) crash on a second load
defects.failure_scenario: The duplicate guard fires even when the SAME factory object is re-registered, and nothing downstream makes registration run only once. Reproduced in /Users/wxy/Desktop/Partura/tmp/impl/review_WP6/sim_wp7.py, which implements WP7 step 1's load_plugins verbatim (importlib.import_module each, call register() if callable) over a module whose register() is the design's WP11 snippet verbatim (`register_scorer('partura', _partura_scorer_factory)`): the first load succeeds, the second dies with `ValueError: scorer kind 'partura' is already registered (pass replace=True to override it)`. import_module is cached, so the module body does not re-run, but load_plugins calls register() again regardless. Three flows hit this as designed: (1) WP8 step 11 builds the plugin list from `--plugin` args PLUS ALPHACUBE_PLUGINS and the design never says it dedups, so `ALPHACUBE_PLUGINS=partura.ac_plugin` together with `--plugin partura.ac_plugin` kills the run before any mining (`load_plugins(['fakeplugin','fakeplugin'])` in the same script raises identically); (2) WP8's own tests/test_cli_daily_and_plugin.py lists at least two cli.main([... '--plugin', '<tmp module>' ...]) cases in one pytest process, so the second one fails; (3) Partura's idea_search.py loops arms and would crash if load_plugins is ever moved inside the loop.
defects.suggested_fix: Make an identical re-registration a no-op, in scoring.py line 536: `if kind in SCORER_FACTORIES and SCORER_FACTORIES[kind] is not factory and not replace: raise ValueError(...)`. A genuine collision (a DIFFERENT factory under the same name) still raises, which is what the design's rule is for. Pin it with a test (`register_scorer('k', F); register_scorer('k', F)` must not raise; `register_scorer('k', G)` must). The alternative — WP7's load_plugins dedups names AND WP11's register() passes replace=True — needs two later packages to both remember, and replace=True there would also silently mask a real name clash between two plugins.

defects.title: make_scorer treats a factory registered as None as "not registered" and blames AlphaCube for a plugin's error
defects.failure_scenario: register_scorer never checks that `factory` is callable, and make_scorer's membership test is `SCORER_FACTORIES.get(kind) is not None` rather than `kind in SCORER_FACTORIES`. Verified in /Users/wxy/Desktop/Partura/tmp/impl/review_WP6/probe.py: `register_scorer('notcallable', None)` succeeds silently, then `make_scorer(target, 'notcallable')` falls through to PanelScorer and reports `ValueError: kind must be ic or rank_ic, not 'notcallable'` — even though 'notcallable' IS in SCORER_FACTORIES and in scorer_kinds(). A plugin that builds its factory conditionally (`register_scorer('partura', getattr(mod, 'factory', None))`) therefore ships a kind that passes WP7's scorer_kinds() guard at GPMiner construction and then dies pointing at AlphaCube's built-in list instead of at the plugin. register_scorer also accepts '' and non-str names (`register_scorer(42, F)` lands in the dict; a later mixed-type registry would make `sorted(SCORER_FACTORIES)` in scorer_kinds() raise TypeError for every caller).
defects.suggested_fix: In register_scorer, before storing: `if not callable(factory): raise TypeError(f'factory for {kind!r} must be callable, got {type(factory).__name__}')`, and `if not isinstance(kind, str) or not kind: raise ValueError('kind must be a non-empty str')`. In make_scorer line 557-558, switch to `if kind in SCORER_FACTORIES: return SCORER_FACTORIES[kind](target, dates=dates, ...)` so a registered name can never fall through to the built-in error.

defects.title: The factory-forwarding test pins only cost_per_side, so silently dropping any other keyword stays green
defects.failure_scenario: Mutation-tested in /Users/wxy/Desktop/Partura/tmp/impl/review_WP6/mutate.py against a copy of the tree (13 mutations, 10 caught). Two survived: deleting `signed=signed` from make_scorer's factory call, and cutting the call down to `factory(target, dates=dates, warmup=warmup, cost_per_side=cost_per_side)` — both leave tests/test_scorer_registry.py at "10 passed". The only forwarded keyword the test asserts on is cost_per_side (line 112); _DummyScorerA swallows the rest in **kw. This matters because the design's WP11 factory is `_partura_scorer_factory(target, *, dates=None, warmup=0, **kw)` — it swallows **kw too, so a dropped keyword would never raise, it would just quietly give ParturaScorer different gates (min_coverage / min_scored_days) or a different turnover charge than make_scorer was asked for. (The implementation forwards all six correctly today; this is the net that would catch it being broken later.) A third mutation that survived, moving the registry lookup ABOVE the `kind in ('long','long_hit')` branch, is harmless as long as register_scorer keeps rejecting built-in names, so no change is needed there.
defects.suggested_fix: Replace line 112 with an assertion on the whole kwarg set, e.g. `assert got.kw == {'turnover_penalty': 0.0, 'signed': False, 'cost_per_side': 0.002, 'top_frac': BOOK_TOP_FRAC, 'min_coverage': 0.5, 'min_scored_days': 0.5}` (importing BOOK_TOP_FRAC alongside the rest), and add one non-default pass through every keyword so a reordered/renamed forward is caught too.

defects.title: Two WP6 tests assert on process-global registry state and will go red when WP7's test module registers at import time
defects.failure_scenario: The _clean_registry fixture snapshots around each TEST, but pytest imports every test module at collection, before any test runs, so a module-scope registration anywhere else in tests/ is already in the dict when the snapshot is taken. Reproduced in the sandbox by adding a stand-in for WP7's tests/test_plugin_hooks.py that calls `register_scorer('wp7_kind', _S)` at module scope (the natural shape when a module-level GPMiner fixture needs the kind): `pytest tests/test_aa_fake_plugin_hooks.py tests/test_scorer_registry.py -q` gives `2 failed, 9 passed` — test_registry_is_empty_by_default (line 66, `SCORER_FACTORIES == {}`) and test_scorer_kinds_sorts_registered_names_after_the_builtins (line 125, `kinds[len(FITNESS_KINDS):] == ('aa_wp6','zz_wp6')`). The risk is that WP7's implementer sees two unrelated WP6 tests fail and weakens them instead of moving the registration into a fixture.
defects.suggested_fix: Make line 125 relative to the snapshot instead of absolute — have the fixture yield the `before` dict and assert `tuple(n for n in kinds[len(FITNESS_KINDS):] if n not in before) == ('aa_wp6', 'zz_wp6')` — and leave line 66 as the deliberate pin of backward_compat item 10, with a comment saying that any test module registering a kind must do it inside a fixture, not at import time.

result.notes:
范围与纪律:只有清单内两个文件被改(`git show --stat 6a4bda1` = src/alphacube/mining/scoring.py +51/-4、tests/test_scorer_registry.py 新增 154 行),worktree `git status --porcelain` 干净,HEAD=6a4bda1,分支 partura-steering。我只在 /Users/wxy/Desktop/Partura/tmp/impl/review_WP6/ 下写了临时脚本(mutate.py / dump_scorers.py / probe.py / sim_wp7.py / sandbox 副本),没碰任何已跟踪文件,没提交、没 push、没连服务器。

(a) 设计逐条核对 — WP6 六步全部落实,签名与设计伪码逐字一致:`make_scorer(target, kind, *, turnover_penalty=0.0, signed=False, cost_per_side=0.0015, top_frac=BOOK_TOP_FRAC, min_coverage=0.5, min_scored_days=0.5, dates=None, warmup=0)`;`register_scorer(kind, factory, *, replace=False)`;`scorer_kinds() = tuple(FITNESS_KINDS) + tuple(sorted(SCORER_FACTORIES))`;三步分支顺序(内置 → 注册表 → PanelScorer)与设计一致;__all__ 三个新名字都加了;PanelScorer / LongScorer / LongHitScorer / FITNESS_KINDS / 所有阈值在 diff 里一个字节没动。register_scorer 的 docstring 协议我对着源码逐条验过:`.score(panel, gated=True)` ↔ gp.py:434、`.score_combined(panel)["fit"]` ↔ env.py:284、`.target_t64`/`.target_ranks_t` ↔ gp.py:325-326、`.columns` ↔ gp.py:876 的 getattr,都对得上;源码里 scorer 被外部读到的属性只有这五个(全仓 grep `_scorer.` / `scorer.` 确认),`orientations` 没有任何外部调用点,所以协议没有漏项。

(b) 默认参数下的行为与随机数流 — 实测而非推理。dump_scorers.py 在两棵树里各跑一遍(PYTHONPATH 分别指向基线 /Users/wxy/Desktop/AlphaCube/src 和 /Users/wxy/Desktop/AlphaCube-steering/src),对同一份带 NaN 洞、带整天全 NaN、带截面无离散度那天的 target/panel,把四种内置 kind × (默认 / 全部调过的参数) 的 `.score()`、`.score_combined()`、columns、target_t64/target_ranks_t 求和、以及全部标量属性按 repr 存成 JSON:两份 JSON **逐字节相同,唯一的差异就是 `__signature__` 多了 `dates`/`warmup` 两个关键字**。新路径在默认参数下只多一次 `dict.get`,不碰任何 RNG,也没有 import 期副作用。全套 637 passed / 10 skipped / 1 xfailed,与「基线 617 + WP1 的 10 + WP6 的 10」完全吻合,没有新失败。

(c) 新路径本身 — `dates`/`warmup` 的因果性契约我顺着源码验到底了:pipeline.py:246 `target, realized = lab.compute(view)` 与 `view.dates` 行对齐,报告端 `target[trim:]`(:448/:454)也用同一个 trim,gp.py 里 `self.target` 整段不切片、rolling block(gp.py:762)也不重建 scorer、`make_scorer` 在 gp.py 里只有 __init__ 一个调用点,所以 WP7 将来写 `dates=list(self.view.dates), warmup=int(warmup)` 时 `len(dates) == target.shape[0]` 成立,`dates[warmup]` 确实对应 `target[warmup]`,docstring 的约定是准的。make_scorer 对 dates/warmup 不做任何校验(warmup=999、warmup=-5、dates 比 target 短都照传不误),这是设计明说的「make_scorer 不切分」,我不当缺陷报,但 WP7/WP8 接线时值得加一句 `assert dates is None or len(dates) == target.shape[0]` 把「静悄悄切错训练/验证段」变成报错 —— 设计里 warmup 存在的理由本身就是防这个。另一处边界:`kind` 传不可哈希对象(如 `['ic']`)现在抛 TypeError,改之前抛 ValueError;CLI 和 pipeline 的 kind 永远是 str,不可达,仅记录。

(d) 测试真伪 — 做了 13 个变异(mutate.py,在 sandbox 副本上改、跑完即还原),10 个被测出来:把 dates/warmup 转发进 LongScorer、让 replace=True 绕过内置保护、scorer_kinds 顺序颠倒、重复注册静默覆盖、warmup 默认值改成 1、转发时 warmup+1、__all__ 掉名字、未知 kind 换成自己的报错文案、转发时丢 cost_per_side、整个注册表被忽略 —— 全红。三个漏网的见 defect #3(两个有价值的:丢 signed / 丢其余四个关键字),第三个(注册表查在内置分支之前)因为内置名注册不进去而无害。

(e) 清单外文件 — 无。gp.py:52 自己还有一份重复的 `FITNESS_KINDS` 字面量、gp.py:307 的守卫、cli.py:330 的 `choices=`、pipeline.py:401 的 RL 调用点都没动,这和实现者的说明一致,也正是 WP7 step 3 / WP8 step 3&12 要接的地方;我全仓 grep 过,除这四处外没有第三个地方枚举 fitness 取值,WP7/WP8 的清单是全的。

实现者自报的两处 deviation 我都确认了,且都无行为影响:`factory: Callable[..., Any]` 的标注符合本文件惯例;docstring 用中文散文 + 英文标识符,技术内容(方法名、"fit"/-inf 语义、dates 含预热行、dates[warmup] 是第一个被打分的日子)一字不差地保留了。另外设计正文「raises on a built-in name and on a duplicate unless replace=True」对「replace 是否绕过内置保护」是有歧义的,实现选了「内置一律不能被覆盖」并用 test_builtin_protection_is_not_bypassed_by_replace 钉死 —— 我认为这是对的那一边(否则插件可以悄悄把 `long` 换掉),只是记一笔。SCORER_FACTORIES 是裸的可变模块级 dict、没有锁,这点与设计一致,AlphaCube 的注册都发生在单线程启动期,不构成问题。

结论:没有 high(没有算错的数、没有破坏向后兼容 —— 跨树逐字节比对已证);一个 medium(插件重复加载会硬崩,修在 scoring.py 一行),三个 low。
